al_munther.name: Al Munther
al_munther.summary: Bahrain's first locally built satellite: a 3U CubeSat from the National Space Science Agency, launched on 15 March 2025 to a 550 km sun-synchronous orbit.

milestone.name: Al Munther's orbit (Bahrain)
milestone.text: Bahrain's first locally built satellite, Al Munther, circles Earth at about 550 km. It was launched on 15 March 2025.
milestone.source: Arab News, citing the Bahrain News Agency (not a NASA source)
